kjv: extol him (God) that rideth upon the heavens (KJV 68:4)
mine: lift up a song to him (God) who rides through the deserts
note: larokhev ba'aravot: 'aravot is "steppes, deserts" (cf. v.8 "through the wilderness"); many compare Ugaritic rkb 'rpt "rider of the clouds", but "heavens" is not the word's meaning (contrast v.34 "rides in the heavens").

kjv: great [was] the company of those that published [it] (KJV 68:11)
mine: the women who announce the news are a great host
note: hamevasserot is feminine plural: women heralds of victory (cf. Miriam, 1Sa 18:6); the KJV's neutral "those" loses this.

kjv: Though ye have lien among the pots (KJV 68:13)
mine: though you men lie among the sheepfolds
note: shefattayim are probably sheepfolds or saddlebags (Judg 5:16 mishpetayim, of those who stayed home); "pots" is a rabbinic guess.

kjv: thou (God) hast received gifts for men (KJV 68:18)
note: laqahta mattanot ba'adam "you took gifts among/from men" (tribute from the defeated); Eph 4:8 quotes a tradition (also in the Targum) "he gave gifts to men", which the KJV's "for men" harmonises toward.

mine: Rebuke the beasts that dwell among the reeds
note: hayyat qaneh is "the beast of the reed", the hippopotamus or crocodile as a figure for Egypt; the KJV takes qaneh as "spear".
